metadata.name: noised_autopilot
metadata.description: Noised Autopilot: PXG1 automation graphs that run a launched token's treasury (buy back and burn, burn, pay declared recipients) inside fixed on-chain bounds, changed only by the creator's post-quantum identity after a 72-hour timelock

instructions.name: activate
docs: Queue a published graph to take effect at `activate_at`, authorized
by the launch's post-quantum identity (permissionless).

accounts.name: graph
docs: The published graph to queue.

accounts.name: authorization
docs: (`launchpad::check_authorization`).

instructions.name: apply_pending
docs: Make the queued graph active at or after its time (permissionless).

accounts.name: graph
docs: The queued graph.

instructions.name: bind_mint
docs: Bind the autopilot to the launch's certified mint once the launch is
live; create the treasury's token account (permissionless, once).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone: pays the treasury token account's rent.

accounts.name: certificate
docs: (`launchpad::check_certificate`).

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint (Token-2022).

instructions.name: bind_pool
docs: Bind the autopilot to the DAMM v2 pool DBC's migration created for
the launch: from then on it has graduated (permissionless, once).

accounts.name: damm_config
docs: (`external::check_migration_config`).

accounts.name: damm_pool
docs: (`external::read_pool`).

instructions.name: freeze
docs: Make the active graph permanent, authorized by the launch's
post-quantum identity until `not_after`, which the authorization
signs (permissionless).

instructions.name: init_autopilot
docs: Create a launch's autopilot and its treasury's wSOL account
(permissionless, once).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone: pays the autopilot's and the treasury wSOL account's rent.

accounts.name: dbc_config
docs: (`external::migration_sqrt_price`).

accounts.name: treasury
docs: this program's CPIs.

accounts.name: treasury_wsol
docs: The treasury's wSOL account (created if `distribute` has not yet).

instructions.name: publish_graph
docs: Publish a verified PXG1 graph at the address its content hashes to
(permissionless, idempotent).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone: pays the record's rent.

instructions.name: revoke_operator
docs: Clear the operator, authorized by the launch's post-quantum identity
(permissionless).

instructions.name: run
docs: Run one due node of the active graph and tip the caller
(permissionless; operator-gated nodes need the operator and its
amount; a keeper may choose a smaller buyback amount).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone: the keeper (or the operator). Receives the tip.

accounts.name: operator
docs: The graph's operator: required for operator-gated nodes.

accounts.name: graph
docs: The active graph.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable: burns reduce the supply.

accounts.name: damm_pool
docs: layout (`external::read_pool`); none before. Writable in the
transaction only for a buyback.

accounts.name: tip_account
docs: Any wSOL account: receives the tip.

instructions.name: update_price
docs: Observe the pool's price and move the reference toward what the
observations agree on (permissionless, any time after graduation).

errors.name: NotALaunch
errors.msg: Account is not a Noised launchpad launch

errors.name: LaunchNotLive
errors.msg: The launch is not live yet

errors.name: InvalidCertificate
errors.msg: Certificate is not the launchpad's for this launch and mint, or lacks a safety check

errors.name: InvalidDbcConfig
errors.msg: DBC config is not the launch's (wSOL quote, migration price)

errors.name: MintAlreadyBound
errors.msg: The autopilot's mint is already bound

errors.name: MintNotBound
errors.msg: The autopilot's mint is not bound yet (bind_mint once the launch is live)

errors.name: InvalidGraph
errors.msg: Graph bytes do not verify as PXG1

errors.name: GraphMismatch
errors.msg: Graph record is not the one this autopilot names

errors.name: InvalidAuthorization
errors.msg: Authorization is not the launch identity's authorization of this action

errors.name: StaleAuthorization
errors.msg: Authorization landed before one already used

errors.name: Frozen
errors.msg: The graph is frozen forever

errors.name: NoActiveGraph
errors.msg: No graph is active

errors.name: NoPendingUpdate
errors.msg: No graph update is pending

errors.name: ActivationInPast
errors.msg: A first graph must activate now or later

errors.name: TimelockTooShort
errors.msg: A graph update must take effect at least 72 hours after it is queued

errors.name: UpdateNotDue
errors.msg: The pending graph update is not due yet

errors.name: PendingUpdateDue
errors.msg: A graph update is due: apply it first

errors.name: NoOperator
errors.msg: There is no operator

errors.name: NoSuchNode
errors.msg: No such node in the active graph

errors.name: NodeNotDue
errors.msg: The node is not due

errors.name: NotGraduated
errors.msg: The token has not graduated to its DAMM v2 pool

errors.name: MaxRunsReached
errors.msg: The node ran as often as allowed this epoch

errors.name: BudgetSpent
errors.msg: The node spent its budget for this epoch

errors.name: ConditionFalse
errors.msg: The node's condition does not hold

errors.name: WrongOperator
errors.msg: Only the graph's operator can run this node

errors.name: AmountNotAllowed
errors.msg: Only operator-gated nodes and buybacks take an amount

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: The amount must be above zero and within the node's cap and the treasury

errors.name: NothingToDo
errors.msg: The treasury holds nothing this node could move

errors.name: PremiumExceeded
errors.msg: The pool price is above the reference price plus the node's premium

errors.name: PriceOutOfRange
errors.msg: The reference price is out of range for this swap

errors.name: SwapShortfall
errors.msg: The swap did not take exactly the amount in or returned less than the minimum

errors.name: InvalidPool
errors.msg: Pool is not the launch's DAMM v2 pool

errors.name: InvalidDammAccounts
errors.msg: DAMM v2 accounts are missing or wrong

errors.name: InvalidRecipientAccounts
errors.msg: Recipient accounts are missing or wrong

errors.name: PriceNotObserved
errors.msg: Observe the pool price first (update_price), then run at least a minute later

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: UnexpectedAccounts
errors.msg: This action takes no remaining accounts

errors.name: AmountTooSmall
errors.msg: A keeper's buyback must move at least 1% of the pool's SOL (or the node's whole amount)

errors.name: InvalidDammConfig
errors.msg: DAMM v2 config is not one DBC migrates through

errors.name: PoolAlreadyBound
errors.msg: The autopilot's pool is already bound

errors.name: FreezeExpired
errors.msg: The freeze authorization is past its not_after

errors.name: RemainderTooSmall
errors.msg: A keeper's partial buyback must leave at least 1% of the pool's SOL of the node's amount (or move all of it)

errors.name: NoRecipientAccount
errors.msg: No recipient of a share has a wSOL account to receive it

types.name: AuthMark
docs: The latest authorization of one kind that was used (`governance.rs`):
authorizations are ordered by `(slot, address)`, so each is used at most
once and never after a newer one of the kinds that could undo it.

types.name: Autopilot
docs: A launch's autopilot, at `["autopilot", launch]` (spec §4). Created by
anyone; changed only by the instructions of this program: the graph only
through a post-quantum authorization of the launch's identity and the
timelock, the node states only by successful runs, the reference price
only toward what observations of the pool agree on (`reference.rs`).

fields.name: treasury_bump
docs: Bump of the treasury authority `["treasury", launch]`.

fields.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint, bound once it is live (`bind_mint`; default until
then).

fields.name: damm_pool
docs: The launch's DAMM v2 pool, bound once DBC migrated the curve
(`bind_pool`; default until then: the launch has not graduated).

fields.name: active_graph
docs: Hash of the graph that runs (zero: none yet).

fields.name: pending_graph
docs: An authorized graph waiting for `activate_at` (zero: none).

fields.name: pending_operator
docs: The operator the pending graph gets when applied (its own, unless a
revocation took it away).

fields.name: activated_at
docs: When the active graph took effect.

fields.name: frozen
docs: The active graph can never change again (`freeze`).

fields.name: operator
docs: The active graph's operator, the only signer of its operator-gated
nodes (default: none, or revoked).

fields.name: auth_marks
docs: The latest authorization used, per kind (activate, freeze, revoke).

fields.name: seq
docs: Successful runs so far, across all nodes and graphs.

fields.name: ref_sqrt_price
docs: The reference sqrt price (Q64.64) price conditions read and that
bounds buybacks: seeded with the launch's migration price, then moved
toward the prices observations of the pool agree on, rising at most
5% per hour.

fields.name: ref_updated_at
docs: When the reference last moved (0: never).

fields.name: ref_allowance
docs: The rise allowance (sqrt-bps-seconds) and when it last accrued.

fields.name: observations
docs: Observations of the pool price: the current bucket, then the
previous one.

fields.name: tip_epoch_start
docs: The tip epoch `tips_in_epoch` counts (a multiple of `TIP_EPOCH_SECS`).

fields.name: nodes
docs: Indexed like the active graph's nodes.

fields.name: active_auth
docs: The launchpad `Authorization` that activated the active graph and the
`activate_at` it signed (audit 4, A4-S; set by `apply_pending`): with
`active_graph` they give the authorization's payload hash, so anyone
can re-verify the running graph's LMS signature from this account.
A revocation names this authorization (`revoke_payload`). Default
and 0 until a graph is active.

fields.name: partial_spent
docs: Indexed like the nodes: what keepers' partial buybacks moved since
the node last completed a run (audit 4, A4-2). Until it does, a run
moves at most `p1` minus this, so splitting a run never moves more
than the run would. Cleared by a completed run and by a new graph.

fields.name: ref_sqrt_price
docs: The launch's migration price: the first reference price.

fields.name: cancelled
docs: A pending update the freeze cancelled (zero: none).

types.name: GraphPublished
docs: `publish_graph` created a graph record (not emitted when it existed).

types.name: GraphQueued
docs: An authorized graph was queued; it takes effect at `activate_at`.

fields.name: operator
docs: The operator the graph will have (its own).

types.name: GraphRecord
docs: A published PXG1 graph, at `["graph", launch, graph_hash]` where
`graph_hash = SHA256("PHX-GRAPH-V1" || bytes)`. Created whole by
`publish_graph` after `Graph::verify`, never modified or closed.

types.name: NodeRan
docs: A node ran. Every lamport and token that left the treasury is here.

fields.name: spent
docs: What the node spent from its budget: lamports swapped (BUYBACK_BURN)
or due to the recipients (DISTRIBUTE_SOL: paid, plus `kept`), tokens
burned (BURN).

fields.name: bought
docs: Tokens bought by the swap (all burned in the same instruction).

fields.name: burned
docs: Tokens burned (bought ones, or treasury tokens).

fields.name: tip
docs: Lamports of wSOL paid to the caller's tip account.

fields.name: spot_sqrt_price
docs: The pool's sqrt price before the action (0 before graduation, or if
a burn or a distribution could not read it).

fields.name: ref_sqrt_price
docs: The reference sqrt price after the run.

fields.name: partial
docs: A keeper's partial buyback (audit 4, A4-2): it spent from the budget
but did not complete the node's run, so the node stays due (not a
run: `last_run`, `last_seq` and the epoch's runs are unchanged).

fields.name: skipped
docs: DISTRIBUTE_SOL: bit `i` set when recipient `i` had no wSOL account
at its canonical address (audit 4, M4): its share was not paid.

fields.name: kept
docs: Lamports of those shares, which stayed in the treasury (paid =
`spent - kept`).

types.name: NodeRecord
docs: A graph node's run state (`noised_rules::NodeState`, stored).

fields.name: last_run
docs: Unix time of the last successful run (0 = never).

fields.name: last_seq
docs: `Autopilot::seq` at the last successful run (0 = never).

fields.name: epoch_start
docs: Start of the epoch the two counters below count.

fields.name: spent_in_epoch
docs: Lamports (BUYBACK_BURN, DISTRIBUTE_SOL) or raw tokens (BURN).

types.name: ObsBucket
docs: The lowest and highest pool price observed during one bucket of
`OBS_BUCKET_SECS` (`reference.rs`). Empty while `min == 0` (no pool has a
zero price).

fields.name: index
docs: `unix_time.div_euclid(OBS_BUCKET_SECS)` of the observations.

fields.name: first_at
docs: When the first of them was made.

fields.name: min
docs: Lowest and highest sqrt price (Q64.64) observed.

fields.name: pending_cleared
docs: The queued graph named the same operator, which it will not get.

types.name: PoolBound
docs: The launch graduated: its DAMM v2 pool, created by DBC's migration
through `damm_config`, is bound.

types.name: ReferencePriceUpdated
docs: `update_price` observed the pool price; the reference moved if the
observations of the window agreed (`old == new` otherwise).
